messages.author: d8a890e92d218b0c
messages.subject: set priority/nice
parts:
What would be a method to set the default priority R processes threads
in rapache?

I want to prevent a server that gets overloaded with R jobs from
taking down the server. Hence the R job should be run with a lower
priority / higher nice level than e.g. the apache2 root process.

Any ideas?
